about_the_game:
6 neighborhoods,  35 stickers missing,  1 helpless crush!

Before the Sunday is over, Lucas needs to gather stickers to complete an album he plans to gift his secret crush, Leo, so he can finally confess his feelings. Join him and Carol, his ironic best friend, as they explore different parts of a gorgeous watercolor city in six chapters, meeting weird-ass curious characters as you solve tons of fun logic, drawing and jigsaw puzzles in a heartfelt coming-of-age story!

  • Help Lucas complete a sticker album before Sunday ends and confess to Leo, the love of his life total babe soulmate his friend!

  • Explore a stunning watercolor São Paulo with his ironic best friend, Carol.

  • Meet delightfully weird characters and solve fun logic, drawing, and jigsaw puzzles.

  • Experience a heartfelt coming-of-age story filled with humor and charm, set to an original lo-fi soundtrack by Nicobé.

  • After the story, relax with endless puzzle mode!

HIGHLIGHTS

  • The Dialogue: The most charming dialogue ever put in a video game —guaranteed, and we promise that’s only a slight exaggeration!

  • The Characters: Laugh, cry, and get completely attached to unforgettable characters, like cute cats and dogs, and even some humans (gasp)!

  • The Puzzles: Draw, paint, and piece together puzzles—connect dots, recreate images, and think outside the frame to solve creative challenges!

  • The World: Explore a stunning watercolor São Paulo across six chapters, each set in a unique neighborhood!

  • Collect Them All: Collect all stickers as you solve puzzles to get The One True Ending to Rule Them All!

  • After you finish the story mode, turn A SUNDAY AFTERNOON into a relaxing puzzle game, to the tunes of some amazing lo-fi music by Nicobé!
